run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-15T11:31:40Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by a downstream failure chain that starts at the ad service. At 2026-11-15T11:31:09Z the ad container in pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 was OOMKilled (exit code 137, restart count 1) and its replacement started at 11:31:10Z. From that moment the ad service stopped processing GetAds: its server spans for operation oteldemo.AdService/GetAds fell to 0 and stayed at 0 through 11:42:40, while the frontend service's client spans for op grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds went from 0 ERROR to ~150 ERROR per 2-minute window with UNSET dropping to 0, and the frontend server operation GET /api/data went to 100% ERROR. The failing GetAds spans are short (413 of 455 in 10 minutes finished in <=10 ms), i.e. fast gRPC failures rather than request timeouts. The frontend's other dependency operations (CartService/GetCart, AddItem, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, PaymentService/Charge, GET/POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout) show 0 ERROR spans throughout, so the failure is specific to the ad path. frontend-proxy is the reporter at the edge: over 11:37:04-11:43:04 its ingress recorded 254.6 ERROR spans of 2709.9 UNSET and its 'router frontend egress' span 253.5 ERROR of 2711.0, i.e. proxy ingress errors mirror the errors it receives from frontend. The restarted ad container never became functional: its CPU is pinned at ~0.0496 cores (the 50m limit) with ~1200 throttled CFS periods per 2 minutes (100% of periods) versus ~0.004-0.007 cores and 25-80 throttled periods before the crash, and its working set is climbing again after the restart. The ad Deployment has a 450Mi memory limit and 50m CPU limit and defines no readiness or liveness probe, so the pod reports Ready and stays in the ad Service Endpoints while not serving. Nodes show no MemoryPressure/DiskPressure/PIDPressure, so node-level pressure is not the cause.

claims.text: frontend-proxy error spans began at ~11:31-11:33 and grew to 521.7 ERROR spans per 12m for span 'ingress' and 519.7 per 12m for span 'router frontend egress' by 11:42:40, versus 0 for 'router frontend egress' before 11:32:10 (ingress had a pre-existing low baseline of ~2-7 per 12m).

In the last 6 minutes of the window (11:37:04-11:43:04) frontend-proxy ingress recorded 254.57 ERROR spans against 2709.89 UNSET, and span 'router frontend egress' recorded 253.47 ERROR against 2710.99 UNSET; the ingress and egress error counts match, showing the proxy is relaying upstream errors rather than originating them.

The frontend service's server operation 'GET /api/data' had 0 ERROR spans until the 2-minute window ending 11:33:10, then ERROR rising to 158.67 per 2m (window ending 11:41:10) while UNSET fell to 0 from the window ending 11:34:40 onward; other frontend operations (GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, POST) stayed at 0 ERROR.

The frontend service's client operation 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' went from 0 ERROR to 60-170 ERROR per 2-minute window from the window ending 11:33:10 onward, with UNSET at 0 from the window ending 11:34:40 onward, while frontend client operations for CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and PaymentService/Charge show 0 ERROR in every sample.

The ad service's server operation 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' fell from 121.3 spans per 2m at 11:31:40 to 53.3 at 11:32:10-11:32:40 and to 0 from the window ending 11:33:10 through 11:42:10; the 12m increase declined from 683.5 (11:41:40) to 41.1 (11:42:40), and no ad GetAds spans carried ERROR status at any point.

Pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 container 'ad' has restartCount 1 and lastState terminated with reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, startedAt 2026-11-15T10:54:08Z and finishedAt 2026-11-15T11:31:09Z; the current container state is running since 2026-11-15T11:31:10Z and the pod's Ready condition became True at 11:31:10Z.

Deployment 'ad' runs 1 replica with container image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad, memory limit 450Mi (request 225Mi), cpu limit 50m (request 10m), containerPort 8080, and defines neither readinessProbe nor livenessProbe; status shows availableReplicas 1 and readyReplicas 1.

The ad container's CPU after the restart is pinned at ~0.0408-0.0497 cores (the 50m limit) from 11:33:40 onward, and its CFS throttled periods rose from 24-80 per 2m before the crash to ~1100-1200 per 2m from 11:33:10 (1200 periods per 120s at a 100ms period = every period throttled), versus ~0.004-0.007 cores used before 11:31.

The ad container's memory working set rose from ~301 MB at 11:06:00 to ~334 MB at 11:31:10, samples of 420438016 bytes (~401 MiB, near the 450Mi limit) appear at 11:32:10-11:33:10, and after the restart the series reads ~225-283 MB, ending at 281948160 bytes at 11:42:40.

The failing frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' ERROR spans are fast failures: of 455.06 ERROR spans in the 10 minutes ending 11:42:40, 389.90 were <=2 ms, 412.65 <=10 ms, 442.65 <=100 ms and all 455.06 <=400 ms, so they are not long timeouts.
The ad Service Endpoints contain only pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 at ip 100.96.4.112, port 8080 (tcp-service), so traffic continues to be directed to that pod while it serves no requests.
All 5 nodes report MemoryPressure False, DiskPressure False, PIDPressure False and Ready True, so no node-level resource pressure was present at query time.

The ad container was still healthy in its own logs before the crash: lines up to 2026-11-15T11:31:06.817405Z show normal handling ('no baggage found in context', 'Targeted ad request received for [telescopes]', 'Non-targeted ad request received...'); the readable log stream contains 1196 lines and its newest line is 11:31:06.817405Z.
Kubernetes events for pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 in the window are only Normal 'Pulled', 'Created' and 'Started' (counts 2 each, last at 11:31:09-11:31:10); no Evicted or OOMKilling event was returned.

The frontend-proxy pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-whhck and the frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-cmhqq each have restartCount 0 and an empty lastState (no container termination), so neither pod restarted during the incident.

Prometheus holds only two metric names for service_name="frontend-proxy" in the window: traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket; no HTTP-specific or request-level metric series was found for the alerting service under that label.

The fraud-detection container in pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-wbm7f was also OOMKilled (exitCode 137, finishedAt 2026-11-15T11:08:41Z, restartCount 1), 23 minutes before the error onset on the ad path.

Primary cause: the ad service stopped serving GetAds when its container was OOMKilled at 11:31:09Z and the replacement container never began accepting/serving RPCs (0 oteldemo.AdService/GetAds server spans and 0 server-side ERROR spans from 11:33:10, while the frontend's GetAds client spans fail 100% within milliseconds). The exact mechanism inside the restarted container (not listening vs. hung) is not established, but the container's CPU being pinned at its 50m limit with every CFS period throttled is the strongest observable reason it cannot serve.

Call path (inferred from operation names and matching counts, not from trace parent references, since Jaeger returned no spans): frontend-proxy 'router frontend egress' ERROR spans correspond to 5xx responses from frontend, whose 'GET /api/data' server spans are 100% ERROR because its 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' client spans are 100% ERROR; the proxy's matching ingress/egress error counts (254.57 vs 253.47 in 6m) support this relay structure.

Contributing cause: the ad container's 450Mi memory limit is too small for this workload, as shown by a working set of ~310 MB to ~334 MB in normal operation, ~401 MiB samples around the crash, and a restart at 11:31:09 with reason OOMKilled; the post-restart working set is climbing again (~225 MB to ~283 MB), so a repeat OOM is plausible.

Second contributing cause: the ad Deployment defines no readinessProbe, so the pod is reported Ready (Ready=True since 11:31:10) and remains the sole endpoint of the ad Service even while it serves no requests, which keeps frontend traffic pointed at a non-serving pod instead of failing away from it.

Node-level memory or resource pressure is rejected as the cause: all 5 nodes report MemoryPressure False, DiskPressure False and PIDPressure False, and the other 17 pods sharing node i-06e4f0f4f681d7e45 with the ad pod are Running and Ready.

A fault originating in frontend-proxy itself is rejected: its container did not restart, and its ingress error count (254.57) matches its 'router frontend egress' error count (253.47) in the last 6 minutes, i.e. the proxy is relaying errors received from frontend rather than generating them.

A general frontend/network-wide fault is rejected: frontend client operations to other dependencies (grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge) and its other server routes show 0 ERROR in every sample, so only the ad-dependent path fails.

The flagd EventStream errors seen on ad, fraud-detection, recommendation and payment (about 1.04-1.09 per 12m, e.g. ad from 11:31:10 and fraud-detection from 11:38:10) are considered and rejected as the cause of this alert: they are single low-rate errors on a streaming connection present across multiple services, and ad received zero GetAds requests in the same period, so they cannot explain a 100% GetAds failure.

The fraud-detection OOMKilled restart at 11:08:41Z is not part of this error chain: it happened 23 minutes before the first frontend GetAds errors (first nonzero in the 2-minute window ending 11:33:10) and fraud-detection shows no error-rate increase beyond the ~1 per 12m flagd EventStream noise.

Investigate and recover the ad container directly: confirm whether the process in ad-554b849958-fcl25 is listening on port 8080, and restart/roll the ad Deployment so the pod is recreated rather than left running without serving.

Address the resource configuration of the ad Deployment: raise the 450Mi memory limit (and/or set a JVM heap sized to the container limit) to stop the OOMKilled restarts, and raise the 50m CPU limit, which is fully throttled and leaves the restarted JVM unable to serve.

Add a readinessProbe (and livenessProbe) to the ad Deployment on port 8080 so a non-serving container is removed from the ad Service Endpoints instead of continuing to receive frontend traffic while marked Ready.

gaps: Jaeger returned no traces for service frontend, frontend-proxy or the ad path in the incident window (traces_search for frontend-proxy 11:28-11:43:04, traces_search_by_tags frontend error=true 11:35-11:43:04, traces_search frontend 11:40-11:43:04 all returned no data), so no parent-child span references were available and the ad -> frontend -> frontend-proxy call path could only be inferred from operation names and matching span counts.

The ad container log query for 11:31:10-11:43:04 returned no lines (status no_data), and the previous container instance was reported unavailable (HTTP 400 previous terminated container not found); therefore whether the restarted ad container logged anything, and any startup/OOM diagnostic in its output, is unknown.

Prometheus returned no alerting rule named RequestErrorRate (list_prometheus_rules rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned no data), so the alert's exact expression and the reported value 1.5333 could not be reproduced or reconciled with the traces_span_metrics error counts.

The mechanism inside the restarted ad container (whether the process is not listening on 8080, hung, or still initializing its JVM) could not be observed: no exec/port probe or container start logs were available, so the reason the container is CPU-saturated and unresponsive remains a hypothesis.

No OOMKilling or Evicted Kubernetes event was returned for pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 (only Pulled/Created/Started); the OOM is established from the container lastState, not from an event, and event retention may have dropped it.
The change_history data source is not integrated in this run, so whether ad's memory/CPU limits or image were changed shortly before 11:31:09Z could not be checked.

Service-level health of ad's dependencies (flagd) and of other otel-demo services not returned in the error-series query (e.g. currency, email, image-provider, product-catalog, quote, shipping) was not verified; absence of returned ERROR series for them is unknown, not zero.
next_steps: Check on the host whether the ad container's process is listening on port 8080 and, if not, capture its thread dump/startup logs before restarting it.
Review the ad Deployment resource settings against actual usage (450Mi memory limit with ~310-334 MB steady state and ~401 MiB peaks; 50m CPU limit fully throttled after restart) and correct them.
Verify after remediation that ad server spans for oteldemo.AdService/GetAds resume and that frontend GET /api/data and frontend-proxy ingress error rates return to their pre-11:31 baseline.
Add readiness/liveness probes to the ad Deployment so Kubernetes removes a non-serving pod from Service endpoints.
